test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ways**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Way** is used in '**method or style**', '**route, direction, road**' and '**distance**':
 
• The Plural form of '**way**' is '**ways**'.
 
• Here in the passage which is based on environment, the line **Humans have affected the environment in multiple 'ways' like clearing of forests, building houses and farms, making roads, etc.**
 
• **Ways **is suitable here because the sentence is trying to say that humans have affected the environment in different methods.
 
• Hence The correct word to be used is **ways**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's look at the other options;

 
• Plans is used when we talk about something to do in future **(योजना, विचार)**.
 
• Course: a complete series of lessons or studies **(****पाठ्यक्रम)**.
 
• Means: a method or way of doing something **(माध्यम)**.
